# Settings for Star Miner
{
  "player": "Julia",
  "volume": 0.8,
  "graphics": {
    "fullscreen": true,
    "resolution": { "width": 1920, "height": 1080 },
    "shadows": "high"
  },
  "controls": ["W", "A", "S", "D"],
  "saves": [
    { "name": "Moon base", "level": 4 },
    { "name": "Asteroid", "level": 7, "hard": true }
  ],
  "cheats": null,
  "mods": []
}
---
get player
get graphics.resolution.width
get controls[2]
get saves[1].name
get saves
type volume
type cheats
type graphics
get graphics.colour
get saves[5].name
print graphics
print mods
print saves[0]
fly away
quit
